structure.purpose: Your front page: pick up what you were playing, then find what to play next, owned or not. No search bar.

sections.name: Filter
sections.holds: A single choice: All, Music, Podcasts, Books. Each single type gets its own tailored page.

sections.name: Quick picks
sections.holds: Six in All: last played music, last played podcast content as you left it, last played audiobook, and one "Are you feeling lucky?" pick per type.

sections.name: Up next
sections.holds: The next episode or chapter, like Jellyfin's Next Up, with your second most recent book or show kept visible.

sections.name: Context shelves
sections.holds: "More like", "Popular with listeners of", "Based on your interest in": each names its subject, with the subject's art. External cards carry a reason line and play, request or add.

sections.name: Feature cards
sections.holds: One item argued for at length, with a blurb and a Preview.

sections.name: Most played
sections.holds: Orphaned songs only, never the tracks of an album you played whole.

sections.name: The UI kit's shelves
sections.holds: Recently added, Artists & authors, Picked for you, Recently played: drawn from the Sonora kit, not yet checked against your carousel rules.

structure.empty: A new account with no listening yet: the filter and one "Are you feeling lucky?" pick per type. Shelves appear once there is history to seed them. Open: the wording.

structure.purpose: Everything you asked for that is still on its way: albums, books and shows.

sections.name: In flight
sections.holds: One row per request: source, size, percentage and its status pill, from Requested to In library.

sections.name: Needs choice
sections.holds: Album torrents where no release clearly wins: the candidates with format, track fit, size and seeders, picked in one tap.

sections.name: Actions
sections.holds: Retry or cancel on each row.

structure.empty: Nothing requested: says so, and that Search is where things are requested.

structure.purpose: One Browse carousel opened in full ("See all").

sections.name: Header
sections.holds: The shelf's eyebrow, subject and subject art, as on Browse.

sections.name: Items
sections.holds: Every item of the shelf, paged, as a list or a grid.

structure.empty: A shelf with no items is never offered on Browse. Reached by an old link, it says the shelf has gone.

structure.purpose: Your music library: only what is yours, plus your requests. Outside music lives on Browse and Search.

sections.name: Tabs
sections.holds: Artists, Albums, Songs, as the Sonora kit has them.

sections.name: Sort and view
sections.holds: Sort by title, artist or Random (tap again to reshuffle); a grid or list toggle.

sections.name: Library
sections.holds: A 3-across grid on phones, bigger on desktop. Not-playable items greyed; streamable ones marked, where the marker goes is still open.

sections.name: Playlists and favourites
sections.holds: Where your playlists and favourites sit in the library is not drawn yet.

structure.empty: No music yet: says so, and points to Search to find, play and add music.

structure.purpose: One album, yours or not: play it, queue it, or add it to your library.

sections.name: Header
sections.holds: Cover, title, artist, year, track count and length.

sections.name: Actions
sections.holds: Play; Add to queue (an album's default goes to the end of the queue); the menu's Add to library, a lossless torrent request.

sections.name: Tracks
sections.holds: Numbered rows, the playing one marked. An album you don't own streams from YouTube Music until it arrives.

sections.name: Editions and related
sections.holds: Editions folded under the one album; more by the artist.

structure.empty: Not found, or no tracks resolved: the header, and a line saying why.

structure.purpose: An artist's whole catalogue, owned or not: what Spotify's artist page does, plus a bit more.

sections.name: Header
sections.holds: A round image and the name.

sections.name: In your library
sections.holds: A carousel of what you own by them.

sections.name: Discography
sections.holds: One entry per album; EPs, singles, compilations and live albums in their own groups. Unowned titles greyed and requestable; a setting hides them.

sections.name: Popular and similar
sections.holds: Popular songs, and similar artists from ListenBrainz and Deezer.

structure.empty: Nothing owned by them: the catalogue, all greyed and requestable, without the "In your library" carousel.

structure.purpose: A music playlist you made, in your order. Still to design.

sections.name: Header
sections.holds: Name, song count and length.

sections.name: Songs
sections.holds: Song rows, reorderable.

structure.empty: An empty playlist says how to add songs: from any song's menu.

structure.purpose: The songs you favourited, the same on every device.

sections.name: Songs
sections.holds: Song rows, most recently favourited first.

structure.empty: No favourites yet: says the heart in Now Playing adds one.

structure.purpose: Your audiobook library: the books you own and the ones you requested.

sections.name: Tabs
sections.holds: Authors, Books, Series, Narrators, as the Sonora kit has them.

sections.name: Sort, filter and view
sections.holds: Sort by title, author or Random; a grid or list toggle; Requested and Downloaded (on the phone) filters.

sections.name: Library
sections.holds: Covers with progress; a requested book shows its download progress.

structure.empty: No books yet: says so, and that books are requested from Search.

structure.purpose: One audiobook: resume it, see its chapters, or request it if you don't own it.

sections.name: Header
sections.holds: Cover, title, author, narrator, series and number, progress and rating.

sections.name: Actions
sections.holds: Play or resume, Play next, download on the phone. Unowned: Request, then Requested with its progress.

sections.name: Chapters
sections.holds: Chapter rows on one timeline, the current one marked.

sections.name: About
sections.holds: The description, expandable.

sections.name: Related
sections.holds: The rest of the series and more by the author.

structure.empty: A book you don't own: the header, the about text and Request in place of chapters.

structure.purpose: An author's whole catalogue: your books in full colour, the rest greyed and requestable.

sections.name: Header
sections.holds: A round photo and the name.

sections.name: Series
sections.holds: Their series, each in order.

sections.name: Books
sections.holds: Every book, unowned ones greyed and requestable; a setting hides them.

structure.empty: Nothing owned by them: every book greyed and requestable.

structure.purpose: One series in reading order, with what you own and what is missing.

sections.name: Header
sections.holds: The series name, book count and total length.

sections.name: Books
sections.holds: In series order with their number; owned ones with progress, the rest greyed and requestable.

structure.empty: A series you own none of: every book greyed and requestable.

structure.purpose: The shows you subscribe to, YouTube channels among them, and your lists.

sections.name: Sort and view
sections.holds: Sort, filter, and a grid or list toggle.

sections.name: Shows
sections.holds: Every subscribed show, with its unplayed count.

sections.name: Lists
sections.holds: Listening lists, podcast playlists and digests, The Digest first.

sections.name: Add a YouTube channel
sections.holds: Paste a channel link to add it as a show.

structure.empty: No subscriptions: says so, and points to Search's podcast results or pasting a YouTube channel link.

structure.purpose: One podcast show: its episodes, and whether you follow it. You subscribe to listen.

sections.name: Header
sections.holds: Art, title, host and the subscribe state.

sections.name: Episodes
sections.holds: Newest or oldest first (serial shows oldest first); greyed while you don't follow the show.

sections.name: About
sections.holds: The show's description.

sections.name: YouTube settings
sections.holds: For a YouTube show only: which SponsorBlock segments are cut, and whether Shorts and livestreams come in.

sections.name: Related shows
sections.holds: Apple Podcasts' "You might also like".

structure.empty: Just subscribed: says the episodes arrive within the hour.

structure.purpose: One episode: its notes, and playing or queueing it on the spoken queue.

sections.name: Header
sections.holds: Show art, title, the show, date, length and progress.

sections.name: Actions
sections.holds: Play, Play next, add to a list, download on the phone.

sections.name: Show notes
sections.holds: The episode's description.

sections.name: More from the show
sections.holds: Other episodes of the same show.

structure.empty: An episode of a show you don't follow: greyed, and playing it subscribes you.

structure.purpose: A list that isn't a queue: a listening list, a podcast playlist or a digest. It never takes over your queue.

sections.name: Header
sections.holds: Its name and kind; for a digest, its shows and whether it plays oldest or newest first.

sections.name: Items
sections.holds: A listening list crosses off finished items; a playlist or digest drops an episode once played.

sections.name: Add next
sections.holds: For a listening list: recommendations to add, filterable by type.

structure.empty: An empty list says what fills it: a book's or episode's menu, or the digest's shows.

structure.purpose: Find anything, in your library or outside it. One tap opens it with the keyboard up.

sections.name: Suggestions
sections.holds: As you type: titles, creators and series you have, plus recent searches, each naming its kind.

sections.name: Top result
sections.holds: The single most relevant result, whatever its type.

sections.name: Chips
sections.holds: Filter by kind, Lyrics among them (match a remembered line).

sections.name: Your library
sections.holds: Ranked by relevance; plays straight away, no request action.

sections.name: Outside your library
sections.holds: Music plays from YouTube Music; books and podcasts get Request or Subscribe with live status; more releases fold away.

structure.empty: No query: recent searches. No results: says nothing matched, in your library or outside it.

structure.purpose: The full player for what is playing, its controls matched to the content.

sections.name: Art and titles
sections.holds: Cover, title and creator; the source it plays from.

sections.name: Seek
sections.holds: The seek bar with elapsed and remaining time.

sections.name: Transport
sections.holds: Music: shuffle and repeat. Podcasts and books: the spoken variant, with speed and skip back and forward.

sections.name: Actions
sections.holds: Favourite, sleep timer (end of chapter included); music's speed buried in the menu.

sections.name: About cards
sections.holds: The artist, show or book below the player.

structure.empty: Nothing loaded: Now Playing has nothing to open, and the mini-player is hidden.

structure.purpose: What plays next, on the music queue or the spoken queue, with Back walking your history.

sections.name: Now playing
sections.holds: The current item.

sections.name: Next up
sections.holds: Your queue; nothing leaves it unrecoverably.

sections.name: Autoplay
sections.holds: What follows once the queue runs out.

sections.name: Switching queues
sections.holds: Moving between the music and spoken queues.

sections.name: Edit mode
sections.holds: Reorder, remove, select several.

structure.empty: An empty queue says autoplay continues from the last queue that played.

structure.purpose: The playing song's lyrics, synced where they can be.

sections.name: Sync toggle
sections.holds: Always in the top corner.

sections.name: Lines
sections.holds: Synced: the current line leads. Sync off: every line at full opacity, a dot on the current line (switched off from the menu).

structure.empty: No lyrics found: says so.

structure.purpose: What is on this phone for offline play. Android only; still to design.

sections.name: Downloaded
sections.holds: Each item with its size and a remove action.

sections.name: In progress
sections.holds: Downloads still running.

structure.empty: Nothing downloaded: says a book, episode or album downloads from its page.

structure.purpose: Your preferences and the connections Auralis uses.

sections.name: Look
sections.holds: Theme.

sections.name: Playback
sections.holds: Autoplay rules, the music queue style (YouTube Music or Spotify), gapless.

sections.name: Library
sections.holds: Show everyone's library (off by default); hide unowned titles on artist and author pages.

sections.name: YouTube account
sections.holds: Connect your account for watched state and position; the "YouTube sign-in expired" warning.

sections.name: Services, providers and requests
sections.holds: What the server connects to; admins only for providers, paths and approvals.

structure.empty: Settings always holds its defaults.

structure.purpose: First run: what Auralis needs from you before Browse makes sense.

sections.name: Steps
sections.holds: Onboarding's steps, from the kickoff project's screen list.

structure.empty: Setup done: it goes straight to Browse.

structure.purpose: Sign in through the household's single sign-on.

sections.name: Sign in
sections.holds: One button that goes to the household sign-in.

sections.name: Error
sections.holds: Why signing in failed, and try again.

structure.empty: Already signed in: it goes straight on.

structure.purpose: For admins: each Browse shelf with its reasons, so bad picks are easy to spot.

sections.name: Shelves
sections.holds: Each shelf with its items, every item's reason and source.

structure.empty: No shelves computed yet: says so.

structure.purpose: Where a link to something that doesn't exist lands.

sections.name: Message
sections.holds: Says the page doesn't exist, with the way back to Browse.

structure.empty: It is itself the empty state.
